validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run validate:repo --if-present
validate:fast: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && { out=$(vitest run --changed 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; if [ "$rc" = 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'No test files found' && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ]; then echo 'validate:fast: no tests collected - vitest run --changed found no test files and the working tree is clean, so nothing was tested. Run npm run validate for the full suite, or vitest run --changed <ref> for the commits since <ref>.' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit "$rc"; }
